title: baseCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Base COMP instances, documenting that the class has no operator-specific Python members or methods and relies on inherited COMP behavior for component contents, creation, search, layout, storage, privacy, and custom parameters.
guidance: Use this article to avoid inventing Base COMP Python members or methods when the official class page does not document operator-specific API.

For Base COMP creation, copying, layout, recursive search, progressive unload, tox load/save, and custom parameter workflows, use inherited COMP methods such as create(), copy(), copyOPs(), layout(), findChildren(), progressiveUnload(), loadTox(), save(), and appendCustomPage().
Do not treat inherited COMP members such as extensions, selectedChildren, or internalOPs as baseCOMP-specific members.
Use baseCOMP as a general component container; reach for the generic COMP Class article when the workflow is about children, extensions, storage, privacy, or custom parameters.
